title: Welsh Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew originating from Wales, perfect for a cold evening. This gluten-free version uses juicy cod and welsh ingredients.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onion, carrots, and celery. Cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the chopped leek and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the welsh stew steak and cook until browned.
Add the juicy cod and cook until browned.
Add the tomato paste and gluten-free flour. Cook for 1 minute.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
